title: 伊斯特伯里**克里斯蒂娜·伍德：油价回落但通胀风险犹存，下半年关注什么？
speaker: Christina Wood

segments.en: Sure, that will still impact certain market sentiment as well, but it's really how you stay abreast of that or keep above the market in that sense.
segments.zh: 当然，这仍会影响市场情绪，但关键在于如何跟上市场步伐或保持领先。

segments.en: Yeah, when you look at some of the risks for the second half, I mean, it's interesting that at least the oil price has come down. We're talking more about steady dollar oil here right now, given that there has been progress when it comes to this around war.
segments.zh: 是的，展望下半年的风险，有趣的是至少油价已经回落。考虑到地缘局势取得进展，我们现在更多谈论的是稳定的美元油价。

segments.en: It seems to be slowly but surely opening up in some ways, but the macro risks are still there. I still see traders are pricing in rate height from the Fed.
segments.zh: 市场似乎在缓慢但稳步地开放，但宏观风险依然存在。我仍看到交易员在定价美联储加息。

segments.en: We talked to us about that dynamic. How concerned should we still be about inflation in the second half?
segments.zh: 我们谈到了这种动态。下半年我们对通胀应有多担忧？
